name: Chang Hwa Commercial Bank, Ltd.
summary: Chang Hwa Commercial Bank, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides commercial banking products and services in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers deposits, including checking, demand, time, and savings deposits, as well as negotiable certificates of deposit; and remittances and credit cards. It also provides TWD/foreign currency loans for SMEs projects; personal mortgage loans; syndicated loans; negotiated and discounted, margin, short-term, medium-term, long-term, and overdue loans; and overdrafts. In addition, the company offers foreign exchange, wealth management, and e-banking services. Further, it is involved in trust, international banking, and investment operations; and the provision of life insurance agency and securities brokerage services. The company serves individuals and corporates. It operates through 185 domestic offices; 7 overseas units in New York, Los Angeles, Tokyo, London, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Manila; and 1 representative office in Yangon, as well as 649 ATMs. The company was founded in 1905 and is headquartered in Taichung City, Taiwan.
